description: Great Planes Extra 300S .60 (GPMA0236), 64 in span, O.S. .61FX glow. EXPERIMENTAL first physics estimate (EX-05), generated by research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py; not flight-identified. Visual geometry lives in assets/aircraft/extra-300s-60/geometry.json.

frames.le_frame: positions in metres from the wing leading edge at the centreline (the measured trapezoid's root LE, model z -0.1088): [x_aft, y_right, z_up]; z = 0 on the thrust line (spinner axis)
frames.body: simulation body axes FRD about the CG: x forward = -x_aft, y right, z down = -z_up

wing_area.source: 744 sq in, Great Planes Extra 300S .60 manual EXT6P03 specification (EX-01 measured trapezoid +0.26 %)

wing_span.source: 64 in, Great Planes Extra 300S .60 manual EXT6P03 (EX-01 measured -0.13 %)

mean_chord.source: S / b: the v1 coefficient reference length. NOT the MAC (0.3056 m at 0.3636 m span, assets/aircraft/extra-300s-60/geometry.json (EX-01 metrology))

root_chord.source: root chord extrapolated to the centreline, assets/aircraft/extra-300s-60/geometry.json (EX-01 metrology)

aero_reference_point.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: wing-body aerodynamic centre: 25 % MAC moved forward by the fuselage (Raymer K_fus); on the wing chord plane

level_speed.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: 1.6 x the 1-g stall at the flight mass and CL_max, rounded

plan_cg.source: 4-1/8 in aft of the LE at rib 2D (Great Planes Extra 300S .60 manual EXT6P03 p43) = model z 0 (EX-01 read 4.116 in on the plan); z from the inventory (derived)

cg_tolerance.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: virtual reference build balanced to the manual's point, NOT a measured airplane

mass.source: O.S. catalog 17750 (same engine as the Stik); manual p3 prototype engine

position.source: crankcase ~1.8 in ahead of the firewall

mass.source: manual p3 names it; ~4.5 oz typical for a .61 Pitts-style muffler (no catalog mass found)

position.source: below the engine inside the cowl

glass-filled beam mount

manual p3: five standard servos ~45 g

position.source: axle station from geometry.json; height midway down the leg

position.source: area centroid of the fin polygon

mass.source: clevises, horns, pushrods, screws: rough sum

research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: m = M (x_CG - x0) / (x_ballast - x_CG) for the manual p43 balance point; a virtual reference build, NOT measured hardware or a ballast recommendation (manual: balance with the receiver battery first)

crash_hull.source: Points that hit the ground first (le frame) from assets/aircraft/extra-300s-60/geometry.json (EX-01 metrology): wing tip LE/TE, spinner tip, main wheel bottoms (track estimated there), tail wheel bottom, rudder bottom TE, stab tips, fin top, canopy top. Replaced by gear contact in E1/E2

mass_range.source: Great Planes Extra 300S .60 manual EXT6P03: 7-7.5 lb (3.18-3.40 kg) dry; RCM review build 124 oz (3.52 kg) RTF; widened for fuel

inertia_reference.source: UltraStick25e Jxx Jyy Jzz (1.959 kg, 1.27 m span); compared after scaling by m·b²

aileron.source: Great Planes Extra 300S .60 manual EXT6P03 p43 HIGH rate at the widest part, delta = asin(d / chord): mechanical maximum with transmitter ATV near 100 % (manual); the radio's dual rate reduces it

elevator.source: Great Planes Extra 300S .60 manual EXT6P03 p43 HIGH rate at the widest part, delta = asin(d / chord): mechanical maximum with transmitter ATV near 100 % (manual); the radio's dual rate reduces it

rudder.source: Great Planes Extra 300S .60 manual EXT6P03 p43 HIGH rate at the widest part, delta = asin(d / chord): mechanical maximum with transmitter ATV near 100 % (manual); the radio's dual rate reduces it

servo_full_throw_time.source: Time for a surface to go from neutral to full throw: a standard analog servo at 0.19 s/60 deg (Hitec HS-311 / Futaba S3003 class at 6 V) times about 45 deg of servo-arm travel for full surface throw (typical linkage). Same for every surface

aero.source: Derived from the measured geometry by research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py (Helmbold/DATCOM, tail volume, strip theory, drag build-up); report research/extra-300/ex05/derivation.md. Not flight-identified: EXPERIMENTAL until EX-08/EX-09.

CL_max.source: 13 % symmetric section clmax ~1.15 at Re 3e5 x 0.9 for the wing; no polar identified (EX-09)

CL_min.source: symmetric section: about the positive value, slightly less with the -0.5 deg tail

stall_blend_width.source: same blend as the Ugly Stik data (PicaSim/YASim class)

sideslip_blend.source: Sideslip range where the linear beta terms (CYb, Clb, Cnb) give way to their sin(beta) form, finite and restoring up to knife edge

conventions.rates: p_hat = p·b/(2V), q_hat = q·c/(2V), r_hat = r·b/(2V)
conventions.elevator: per radian, positive = trailing edge DOWN (dCm/dElev < 0)
conventions.aileron: per radian per surface, positive = trailing edge DOWN; right and left listed separately
conventions.rudder: per radian, positive = trailing edge LEFT (dCn/dRud < 0)
conventions.axes: lift, drag, side force in wind axes; roll, pitch, yaw moments in body axes about the aero reference point

CL0.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: symmetric wing at 0 deg; stab -0.5 deg

CLda_each.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: strip theory over the aileron span

CD0.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: component drag build-up at 16 m/s, see derivation.md

CDda_each.source: OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e (via the Stik data file); second-order control drag

CDdr.source: OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e (via the Stik data file); second-order control drag

CDde.source: OpenFlightSim UltraStick25e (via the Stik data file); second-order control drag

CYdr.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: fin slope x Sv/S x rudder effectiveness (must equal the vertical surface)

Clb.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: wing at CL_ref + low-wing interference + fin

Clp.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: strip theory with taper + stab + fin

Cldr.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: rudder side force x fin height above the ARP

Cm0.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: tail incidence about the ARP (wing-body ac)

Cma.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: tail about the wing-body ac; the CG transfer gives the static margin

Cmq.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: tail damping about the CG (undownwashed tail slope) x1.1 for wing/fuselage

Cmde.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: elevator lift x tail arm from the ARP

Cmda_each.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: aileron lift increment at its thin-airfoil centre, arm from the ARP

Cnb.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: fin only (v1 contract: equals the vertical surface)

Cnr.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: fin + wing profile drag + fuselage (-0.02 estimated)

Cnda_right.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: adverse yaw 2 K CL_ref Clda, K 0.15 (Nelson, AR 5.5, taper 0.5)

Cndr.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: rudder side force x fin arm from the ARP (must equal the vertical surface)

wing_aileron_effectiveness.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: |Clda_right| 2n b / (CLa sum(y)) over the loader's equal-area tapered strips

attached_limit.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (retained small-angle oracle validity limit)

tail_local_limit.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (complete local loads before tail stall)

tail_stall_end.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (symmetric tail blend width 12 deg)

tail_CD0.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (estimated, not measured flight data)

tail_k.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (estimated, not measured flight data)

tail_CD90.source: same provisional value as the Ugly Stik surface model (same flat-plate approximation as wing)

area.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: stab + elevator planform polygon from assets/aircraft/extra-300s-60/geometry.json (EX-01 metrology)

position.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: quarter chord of the stab MAC

area.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: fin + rudder side polygon from assets/aircraft/extra-300s-60/geometry.json (EX-01 metrology)

position.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: fin ac: quarter chord at the area-centroid height

incidence.source: symmetric fin; the plan's 2 deg right thrust is not modelled (EX-06)

propulsion.description: Same O.S. MAX-61FX and APC 12x6 data as the Ugly Stik (manual p3 prototype engine). AXIAL thrust: the plan's 2 deg right and 0.5 deg down thrust are not modelled yet (EX-06); the visual model shows a 12x8 stand-in.

max_rpm_static.source: power balance: engine power assumed linear in rpm below the peak (estimated) = static prop power Cp·ρ·n³·D⁵ with Cp 0.0471 → n = sqrt(P_peak/n_peak / (Cp·ρ·D⁵))

lag_time_constant.source: first-order throttle response of a glow engine; replace with a throttle-step measurement

propeller.name: APC 12x6 Sport (LP12060)
propeller.rotation: clockwise seen from behind (standard tractor): the reaction torque rolls the airplane left

ct_table.source: UIUC propeller database vol. 1, measured APC Sport 11x6: apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt (sha256 911866f1…) and apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt (sha256 987b1268…); applied to the 12x6 Sport by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ (APC's own 12x6 file is not reachable here); J = 0 row from the static run at 5,954 rpm, linear between J = 0 and 0.373 (no measurements there)

cp_table.source: UIUC propeller database vol. 1, measured APC Sport 11x6: apcsp_11x6_static_rd0488.txt (sha256 911866f1…) and apcsp_11x6_rd0495_6000.txt (sha256 987b1268…); applied to the 12x6 Sport by T = Ct·ρ·n²·D⁴ (APC's own 12x6 file is not reachable here)

rotating_inertia.source: Propeller + spinner + crankshaft about the shaft, for gyroscopic precession: APC Sport 12x6 about 37 g as a rod (m L^2 / 12 = 2.9e-4) plus spinner, nut and crankshaft (about 0.6e-4). Turns clockwise seen from behind (+x) (2-1/2 in spinner here, within the estimate)

thrust_line_offset.source: research/extra-300/ex05/derive_physics.py: spinner axis relative to the inventory CG; [x_aft, y_right, z_up] from the CG
